Looking for pumpkin spice beyond the chains? Try these Eastside cafes instead

Whether you’re craving pumpkin spice or something different, these Eastside cafes have plenty of drinks and pastries to choose from.
by Jacqueline Ramirez Sep. 22, 2026Sep. 22, 2026

Fall is here, and so are the cozy, seasonal drinks. If you’re looking to skip out on chain lattes and support local instead, this guide is for you.

Whether you’re a pumpkin spice lover or not, these Eastside cafes have a variety of drinks and pastries to choose from.

Cafe Niña

What started as a home-based coffee shop in Boyle Heights has now expanded to a brick-and-mortar location in East Los Angeles. Find their fall menu at both locations. If you’re looking for spooky vibes, ask for a ghost design on the inside of your cup.

  • Pumpkin pillon latte: Pumpkin with piloncillo
  • Durazno Latte: Peach cobbler-inspired latte 

Location:  Boyle Heights: 3264 E. 4th St., Los Angeles, CA 90063

Hours: Tuesday-Friday 7 a.m. to 2 p.m., Saturday-Monday 8:30 a.m. to 2 p.m.

Location:  East Los Angeles: 3923 1/2 E. Olympic Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90023

Hours: Monday-Friday 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., Saturday-Sunday 7:30 a.m. to 1 p.m.

Find them on Instagram @justcafenina.

Acurrúcame Café

Sign up to learn more about The LA Local and get stories worth telling delivered to your inbox.

This cafe is known for specialty drinks available only to customers who order in person. Its pumpkin spice matcha and latte are available now, while the Franken-Berry latte and the Beetlejuice matcha will be available starting September 26. 

  • Pumpkin spice matcha or latte: Made with fresh pumpkin and either matcha or espresso
  • Franken-Berry latte: Made with espresso and blueberries 
  • Beetlejuice: Matcha made with blackberries

Location:  2609 E. Cesar E. Chavez Ave., Los Angeles, CA 90033

Hours: Monday-Friday 7 a.m. to 6 p.m., Saturday 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Find them on Instagram @acurrucamecafe.

Semillas Café y Flores

Pair your fall pastries, including maple pecan blondies, ginger molasses cookies or a slice of pumpkin loaf with your choice of fall drinks: 

  • Carrot cake latte: House-made spiced carrot syrup, espresso, cream cheese cold foam with pecan crunch topping
  • Manzanita tonic: Spiced apple cider, tonic water, espresso, house-made canela syrup with apple crisp topping 
  • Canelita cold brew: House-made canela syrup, Chiapas cold brew with cinnamon cold foam
  • Maple shaken espresso: Maple syrup, sea salt, espresso shaken with ice, topped with a splash of milk and maple cold foam

Location: 1850 1/2 1st St., Los Angeles, CA 90033

Hours: Daily; 6:30 a.m. to 4 p.m.

Find them on Instagram @semillas.la

Cafe Cafe Mobile Coffee

Not a pumpkin spice lover? Cafe Cafe Mobile has you! Its butternut squash latte has been a crowd favorite during the fall season. 

  • Butternut squash latte: An ode to pumpkin spice but with butternut squash spices, topped with cookie crumble.

Location: 2633 E. Cesar E. Chavez Ave., Los Angeles, CA 90033 (Inside Milpa Kitchen)

Hours: Monday-Saturday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m., Sunday 8 a.m. to 12 p.m.

Find them on Instagram @cafecafemobilecoffee.

Cake Girl

Looking for a vegan alternative this fall season? Cake Girl has a variety of pumpkin spice desserts, including cupcakes, donuts, cookies and more. For a fall drink, try the pumpkin spice cold brew.

Location: 2100 1st St, Los Angeles, CA 90033

Hours: Tuesday-Saturday 10:30 a.m. to 6 p.m.

Find them on Instagram @hellocakegirl.

Anhelo Coffee

For all the cookie butter and piloncillo pumpkin lovers out there, Anhelo Coffee has you covered:

  • Cookie butter latte: Cookie butter blended with espresso; iced version available with cream top and sprinkled with crushed Biscoff cookies.
  • Piloncillo pumpkin spice latte: House-made piloncillo pumpkin spice syrup blended with espresso.
  • Piloncillo pumpkin spice cold brew: Cold brew coffee topped with house-made piloncillo pumpkin spice cream.
  • Cookies & cream matcha: Matcha blended with cookies and cream 

Location: 3609 1st St., Los Angeles, CA 90063

Hours: Monday-Friday 7 a.m. to 4 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., Sunday 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.

Find them on Instagram @anhelocoffeeshop.
